key_insight: IteraSim RAG turns OpenFOAM case creation into a staged retrieval-and-agent workflow that better matches distinct query types, reducing single-query and single-agent failure modes.
engineering_relevance: This could make open-source CFD setup more accessible and more reliable for non-specialists configuring solver, turbulence, and boundary-condition inputs.
method: LLM expands each request into physics, solver-keyword, and troubleshooting queries.
Reciprocal Rank Fusion merges ranked lists, then MMR re-ranks candidates from an HNSW dense vector store.
A deterministic router and three agents—Architect, InputWriter, Reviewer—operate with a canonical knowledge layer.
evidence_signal: On an openly released 28-case benchmark, the system achieved 77.9% mean retrieval coverage, all six reference configurations completed on OpenFOAM v2506, and two corrupted cases were repaired within the Reviewer loop.
watch_item: Performance depends on the quality of the static canonical layer and bounded repair loop, so unresolved edge cases may still require expert human verification.
paper_title: IteraSim RAG: A Multi-Stage Retrieval-Augmented Agentic Back-End for OpenFOAM-Based Computational Fluid Dynamics
